purpose: Prospectively transfer the unchanged v54 document-contrastive gate and compact rank-concurrent role closure to the official Doc2Dial v0.9 wOOD source that explicitly contains irrelevant turns.

prior_experiment_boundary.only_v54_aggregate_failure_used: The fixed repository v1.0.1 train exposed 20,431 answer-bearing and zero no-answer target turns, so it cannot test abstention.

official_sources.development_member_resolution: The unique regular JSON member whose normalized path contains /wOOD/ and whose basename denotes the train dialogue split.
official_sources.confirmation_member_resolution: The unique regular JSON member whose normalized path contains /wOOD/ and whose basename denotes the dev or validation dialogue split.
official_sources.document_member_resolution: The unique regular JSON member whose basename is doc2dial_doc.json and is shared by the resolved wOOD dialogue members.
official_sources.wOOD_semantics: The official project README states that dialogues in the wOOD folder include irrelevant turns; request/query/ood is irrelevant to the given document, respond/reply/ood answers Irrelevant, and irrelevant turns have empty grounding references.
official_sources.license_status: The official project page and v0.9 archive link do not state an explicit license. The IBM Hugging Face card for Doc2Dial v1.0.1 says cc-by-3.0, but v55 records this only as related provenance, keeps source bytes ignored and publishes no source text.

source_access_order: Freeze this v55 protocol before downloading doc2dial_v0.9.zip.
Download the official archive into the ignored benchmark cache, hash it and list only regular member names, compressed sizes and uncompressed sizes without opening member content.
Resolve the document, wOOD train and wOOD dev or validation members by the registered path rules; if any resolution is non-unique, publish schema-inconclusive and stop.

Implement and synthetically verify the v0.9 schema adapter, split-isolated archive reader, exact span aliases, OOD eligibility, blind caches and unchanged transferred v54 mechanism before opening any JSON member.
Register protocol, source, implementation, runner and test hashes before opening the document or wOOD train member.
Open only the shared document member and wOOD train member to build the development blind cache; do not open the wOOD confirmation member.
Register development sample commitments, structural census and runtime before query generation or neural scoring.
Score all own-document and deterministic decoy-document candidates before joining target-turn references or OOD labels.
Join development gold once after the complete score cache is locked and execute every registered support gate.

If and only if every development gate passes, freeze the transferred implementation and repeat the blind sequence once on the untouched wOOD confirmation member. Otherwise stop before confirmation content is opened.
Publish positive, negative, null, schema-inconclusive or runtime-incompatible outcomes and forbid reuse of any revealed split for tuning or selection.

task_construction.target_turn: Each agent turn with an immediately preceding user turn in the same wOOD dialogue.
task_construction.query: The exact utterance of the immediately preceding user turn only.
task_construction.answer_bearing: The target agent turn has at least one grounding reference whose official span id exists in the associated document.
task_construction.no_answer: The target reference is empty and either the immediately preceding user dialogue act or target agent dialogue act ends with /ood.
task_construction.excluded_empty_reference: An empty target reference without an adjacent OOD dialogue act is excluded as ambiguous, counted and fails development if the total schema exclusion rate exceeds 0.01.
forbidden_inputs_to_query_or_scorer: raw domain, document or dialogue ids

development_and_confirmation_scope.sampling: Within answer-bearing and no-answer groups, sort by SHA-256 over fixed stage salt, opaque dialogue commitment and turn id; advance groups in lockstep under shared dialogue and per-document-per-state caps.

gold_free_candidate_construction.source: Every non-empty official document span, preserving official text and exact offsets.
gold_free_candidate_construction.canonical_id: Opaque SHA-256 commitment over domain, doc_id and official span id; duplicate exact offset/text spans map aliases to one canonical candidate.
gold_free_candidate_construction.own_document_retrieval_pool: Union BM25 Top-48 and BGE dense Top-48, at most 96 unique spans.
gold_free_candidate_construction.decoy_document_probe_pool: Union BM25 Top-8 and BGE dense Top-8 per probe document, at most 16 unique spans.
gold_free_candidate_construction.post_score_candidate_ceiling: Every distinct referenced span must map to a retained own-document candidate.

transferred_deterministic_role_queries.condition: Find prerequisites, eligibility requirements, conditions, or definitions needed to answer: {query}
transferred_deterministic_role_queries.solution: Find steps, benefits, outcomes, or direct answers that resolve: {query}
transferred_deterministic_role_queries.exception: Find exceptions, exclusions, deadlines, limitations, or cases where this does not apply: {query}

transferred_deterministic_decoys.selection: From other documents in the same domain, prefer the same document-length quartile, then remaining same-domain documents; sort each tier by SHA-256 over fixed v55 decoy salt, opaque case id and opaque document commitment.
transferred_deterministic_decoys.fallback: Other-domain fill is permitted only as a recorded schema fallback; any fallback rate above zero fails development.

transferred_document_contrastive_gate.document_score: Maximum raw anchor-query BGE reranker logit over the document probe pool.
transferred_document_contrastive_gate.pass_rule: The associated document must rank first among itself and seven deterministic decoys, tie-broken by opaque document commitment.

transferred_rank_concurrent_role_closure.selection: After gate pass, select anchor Top-1; then add condition, solution and exception Top-1 winners only when each is also inside anchor Top-3; deduplicate and enforce the token budget.
transferred_rank_concurrent_role_closure.same_gate_frc_ablation: Unchanged low_core_divergence_guarded_frc_v49 after the identical gate.

known_scope_limits: Doc2Dial v0.9 wOOD is English customer-service dialogue, not Chinese flood-response operations.
The balanced mechanism sample is not natural prevalence or an official shared-task submission.
A positive outcome would support only this frozen transfer and would not reproduce SetR, authorize selector rollout or establish flood-domain expert validity.
